reasons.plausibility: The oxidation-based explanation for phase evolution and aluminum depletion under different oxygen pressures is scientifically coherent and aligns with known high-temperature oxidation mechanisms for Al-containing HEAs.
reasons.testability: The proposed experiments (in situ HTXRD, SEM/EDS, Thermo-Calc) are well-defined and could verify or refute the predicted phase/oxide changes, though concurrent wear effects are not investigated.
reasons.usefulness: Because it focuses on high-temperature oxidation rather than the synergy with wear-induced degradation, it only partially addresses the stated research question regarding accelerated coupled wear-corrosion mechanisms.
